title: Shipweek orchestration: cross-signal gating, staggered capacity lanes, and telemetry handoff
creator: Sofia Patel
description: Goal: define and operationalize a 'Shipweek' orchestration pattern that sequences runtime, Console, and API surface launches into staggered capacity lanes with explicit gating signals and telemetry handoffs. This ticket captures the playbook, decision matrix, and stakeholders needed to reduce cross-surface interference during high-risk releases and to enable predictable rollback/fail-forward behavior. Deliverables: a slot-allocation algorithm, gating signal spec (latency/cost/error thresholds), a telemetry handoff contract for post-cutover observability, and an ops escalation checklist.
acceptance_criteria: Playbook doc published in Confluence and linked from the launch calendar
Slot allocator spreadsheet and sample allocations for three canonical scenarios: feature launch, model upgrade, and emergency patch
Gating signals defined with numeric thresholds and automated dashboard alerts; example alerts wired into PagerDuty for on-call teams
Runbook with rollback decision tree and canary ramp plan reviewed and signed by Runtime, Console, and API leads
Two rehearsal sessions executed (one dry-run with shadow traffic, one limited canary) and outcomes summarized
tasks: Map all runtime/console/api dependencies and owner roster
Design slot allocation rules (priority lanes, capacity hedges, surge reserves)
Define gating signals and threshold values (latency p95, error-rate, token-cost variance)
Create telemetry handoff contract (required dashboards, logs, trace spans)
Draft ops escalation and rollback playbook with decision criteria
Schedule two shipweek rehearsals and capture lessons learned
Automate one gating alert to the launch calendar dashboard
notes: Rationale: Recent simultaneous rollouts caused transient KV-cache evictions between the runtime and Console analytics pipeline; locking launch windows reduces blast radius.
We prefer staggered lanes over single blackout windows to preserve business velocity for low-risk updates.
Trade-offs: tighter gating slows some launches; to mitigate we offer pre-signup for high-priority slots and an expedited fast-path for critical security fixes.
Slot granularity: propose 3 lanes (Green: low-impact, Amber: measured canary, Red: reserved/regulated) with associated capacity hedges.
progress_updates: 2026-01-15: kickoff meeting with Runtime, Console, API, SRE. Collected initial dependency map.
